title: Observational Indistinguishability and Integrity Blind Regions in Hybrid Quantum-Classical Workflows
description: Version 1.3.7 corrects a histogram-support defect in the Jensen-Shannon drift sensors and completes the geometry-aligned sensitivity for label-side statistical responses. All datasets, models, splits, seeds, attacks, strengths, kernels, policies and structural theorems remain unchanged. Previous releases remain immutable.
